title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment [Attached Table 1] <Amended on Dec. 15, 2020>

Classification of Fire Equipment (Re: Article 6)

1. Mobile equipment: Equipment fitted with its own power source that can move under its own power or be moved by towing

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Fire engines | Fire pumpers, fire water tankers, chemical fire trucks, aerial fire trucks, unmanned water-discharge vehicles, rescue vehicles, etc. |
| (b) Administrative support vehicles | Administrative and education support vehicles, etc. |
| (c) Firefighting vessels | Fireboats, rescue boats, command boats, etc. |
| (d) Firefighting aircraft | Fixed-wing aircraft, rotary-wing aircraft, etc. |

2. Fire suppression equipment: Equipment used for fire suppression activities

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Firefighting water equipment | Fire hoses, metal hose couplings, fire nozzles, etc. |
| (b) Portable fire extinguishing equipment | Fire extinguishers, portable fire extinguishing equipment, etc. |
| (c) Auxiliary fire suppression equipment | Firefighting ladders, auxiliary fire suppression implements, firefighting pumps, etc. |
| (d) Smoke ventilation equipment | Portable air supply and exhaust fans, etc. |
| (e) Fire extinguishing agents | Powder fire extinguishing agents, liquid fire extinguishing agents, gaseous fire extinguishing agents, etc. |
| (f) Remote-controlled equipment | Remote-controlled firefighting equipment, etc. |

3. Rescue equipment: Equipment used for rescue activities

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) General rescue equipment | Opening equipment, lighting apparatus, firearms, etc. |
| (b) Mountain rescue equipment | Ascending, descending and securing equipment, mountain safety harnesses, rings, etc. |
| (c) Water rescue equipment | Swift-water rescue equipment sets, diving equipment, etc. |
| (d) Chemical, biological, radiological and counter-terrorism rescue equipment | Boundary demarcation lines, decontamination and disinfection equipment, spill collection equipment, etc. |
| (e) Cutting rescue equipment | Cutters, saws, drills, etc. |
| (f) Heavy-load handling equipment | Hydraulic equipment for heavy loads, portable winches (meaning equipment for raising or lowering heavy objects using ropes or chains), multipurpose rescue tripods, etc. |
| (g) Search and rescue equipment | Infrared night-vision devices, buried-person detectors, video transmission and reception equipment sets, etc. |
| (h) Demolition equipment | Axes, fire-door breaching tools, hammer drills, etc. |

4. Emergency medical equipment: Equipment used for emergency medical services

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Patient assessment equipment | Physical examination instruments, etc. |
| (b) First-aid equipment | Airway establishment and maintenance devices, respiratory support devices, devices for restoring heartbeat, etc. |
| (c) Patient transport equipment | Patient carrying equipment, etc. |
| (d) Emergency medical drugs | Pharmaceuticals, disinfectants, etc. |
| (e) Infection prevention equipment | Infection prevention apparatus, equipment disinfection apparatus, etc. |
| (f) Activity support equipment | Recording equipment, personnel protective equipment, general support equipment, etc. |
| (g) Disaster response equipment | Patient triage tags, etc. |
| (h) Education and practical training equipment | Education and practical training equipment for emergency medical services personnel, etc. |

5. Information and communications equipment: Equipment necessary for communication and the exchange and analysis of information in performing fire service duties

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Infrastructure protection equipment | Constant-temperature and constant-humidity equipment, power supply equipment, etc. |
| (b) Information processing equipment | Network equipment, computing equipment, peripheral input and output devices, etc. |
| (c) Satellite communications equipment | Satellite equipment, etc. |
| (d) Wireless communications equipment | Radio stations, mobile communications terminals, etc. |
| (e) Wired communications equipment | Communications control equipment, telephone equipment, video and audio equipment, peripheral devices, etc. |

6. Measurement equipment: Equipment used for various investigations and measurements accompanying the performance of fire service duties

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Firefighting facility inspection equipment | Common facility inspection equipment, fire extinguishing apparatus inspection equipment, fire extinguishing system inspection equipment, etc. |
| (b) Fire investigation and forensic examination equipment | Excavation equipment, recording equipment, forensic examination and appraisal equipment, etc. |
| (c) Common measurement equipment | Electrical measurement equipment, chemical detection and measurement equipment, air component analyzers, etc. |
| (d) Chemical, biological, radiological and other measurement equipment | Radiation measurement equipment, chemical and biological measurement equipment, etc. |

7. Protective equipment: Equipment that protects firefighting personnel at firefighting sites

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Breathing equipment | Air respirators, air supply devices, masks, etc. |
| (b) Protective gear | Fire protective clothing, safety helmets, protective gloves, safety shoes, fire protective hoods, etc. |
| (c) Safety gear | Personal rescue alarms, personnel location tracking devices, personnel escape equipment, etc. |

8. Auxiliary equipment: Equipment needed indirectly or incidentally for the performance of fire service duties

| Category | Items |
|---|---|
| (a) Record preservation equipment | Image capture and sound recording equipment, vehicle operation recording equipment, digital image printers, etc. |
| (b) Video equipment | Video equipment, etc. |
| (c) Maintenance implements | General maintenance implements, washing and drying equipment, etc. |
| (d) Equipment for operating an on-site command post | Command tents, generators, access control lines, etc. |
| (e) Other auxiliary equipment | Vehicle moving devices, safety mats, etc. |

Note: The Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency shall determine matters concerning the standards and procedures for classifying the fire equipment classified in the tables above and the detailed items of fire equipment.
